description.value:
No operative fights entirely alone, and Bolstering Practice specialists take that truth to heart, turning their strikes into rallying cries and their maneuvers into openings for the whole squad. A well-placed hit doesn't just wound the enemy, it sets up the next ally's shot.

These operatives lead from the front, reading the battlefield and calling out the exact moment for a teammate to dash, vanish, or capitalize. Where lone wolves see one target, a Bolstering Practice operative sees a formation waiting to click into place.
